answer.reason: Beyond his lineage, the verses tell that the LORD ordered his inheritance to pass to his daughters because he had no sons.

clauses.english: had his inheritance pass to his daughters at the LORD's word
clauses.quote: thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them

doubts: NUM 27:3 says he died in the wilderness, but only in his daughters' words, so it was left out.
The marriage of his daughters (NUM 36) is their deed, so it was not used.
